args.body:
Hi Alice,

I found the resume template page at www.resume-templates.com and the download links at https://www.resume-templates-portal.com/download_links. However, I'm unable to download the actual template files due to system policy restrictions on external downloads.

The download page offers a "Resume Template (PDF)" link, but the download attempts are being blocked. You may need to visit the site directly to download the template, or I can try alternative methods to get the file to you.

Would you like me to try any other approach, or would you prefer to download it yourself from the website?

Best regards,
Emma
